hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -d docs/data ] || exit 0; if [ -d docs/scripts/renv/library ] && ls -d docs/data/raw/medcap_2* >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f docs/data/processed/respondents.csv ]; then exit 0; fi; echo 'The local setup of this clone is incomplete: the R packages, the MedCap exports or the prepared tables are missing. At the first message, offer to guide the person through the setup step by step with the stilme-setup skill.'
